A.1
Verification Trial Construction
This section provides corpus-specific details supplementing the general trial-generation procedure described in Section
4.2
.
A.1.1
NaturalVoices
NaturalVoices episodes may contain multiple speakers and therefore support all four trial types: Easy Positives, Hard Positives, Easy Negatives, and Hard Negatives. Speaker trials are labeled according to whether the probe and enrollment texts belong to the same speaker. For the demographic tasks, trials are labeled according to whether the speakers share the evaluated sex, age-group, or accent label. For each eligible probe speaker-episode pair, enrollment partners requiring a different episode or speaker are randomly sampled from the corresponding eligible pool using a fixed seed; positive and negative trials are not matched one-to-one by episode or topic. Demographic trials are then retained according to attribute agreement without artificially balancing the classes, so their counts reflect the resulting attribute distributions. For the NaturalVoices speaker ablation, trials are fixed when varying
L
L
at a fixed
P
P
: probe and speaker pairs are unchanged, and only the supplied enrollment utterances differ.
A.1.2
SPoRC
The retained SPoRC episodes are single-speaker. Therefore, different-speaker, same-episode trials cannot be constructed, and all negative trials span different podcast series (characterized by different RSS feeds). Positive speaker trials pair the same speaker across distinct episodes, which may originate from the same or different podcast series. Negative speaker trials pair different speakers from different podcast series and require the speakers to share the same sex, age-group, and accent labels, reducing the possibility that broad demographic differences distinguish the trial classes.
We use two metadata-based topic proxies. First, we concatenate each episode’s title and description and represent the resulting text using L2-normalized TF–IDF features over unigrams and bigrams. Candidate episode pairs with cosine similarity greater than 0.10 are excluded. Second, we represent each podcast series’ non-empty category labels as a set and compute the Jaccard similarity between the two category sets. After the TF–IDF filter, candidate pairs are stratified jointly by TF–IDF similarity and category overlap. For each positive trial, we sample one eligible negative trial from the same stratum, producing balanced trial classes with closely matched distributions of the two metadata-topic measures. We additionally exclude pairs containing exact utterance overlap and screen positive speaker trials for explicit speaker-name leakage.

A.2
Model Scoring and Inference Details
A.2.1
Embedding-based Models
We evaluate pretrained embedding model baselines without task-specific supervised training: sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 (SentenceBERT), AnnaWegmann/Style-Embedding (CISR), Blablablab/multilingual-style-representation (PCM), and rrivera1849/LUAR-CRUD (LUAR). All models are imported from the Sentence Transformers library and run on a single NVIDIA A40 GPU. For SentenceBERT, CISR, and PCM, we average L2-normalized utterance embeddings within each side and compute cosine similarity. TF–IDF uses word unigram and bigram representations fitted without labels to the unique utterances in each task and input configuration. LUAR receives 16 utterances per side: longer sets are truncated, while shorter sets are padded by repeating the final utterance; each utterance is limited to 32 tokens. Probe and enrollment representations are compared using cosine similarity.
A.2.2
LLM Scoring
We query gpt-5-mini through the OpenAI API and meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo and Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B through the Together API. Each trial is presented as a single zero-shot user message. GPT-5-mini uses low reasoning effort and low response verbosity, while Llama uses the provider’s default decoding settings; no temperature is explicitly supplied to either model. For Qwen, we disable reasoning and use temperature (1.0),
top_p
=0.95,
top_k
=20,
min_p
=0, presence penalty (1.5), and repetition penalty (1.0), following the model card’s recommended non-thinking configuration for reasoning tasks. These settings were not tuned on the evaluation labels. We extract the first numeric value from each response and constrain it to the requested 0–100 range.
All three LLMs receive the same prompt structure. The identity-verification prompt is:
You are a speaker verification judge.
Estimate how likely it is that the probe and enrollment utterances came from the SAME SPEAKER. Focus on stylistic and linguistic cues, not topic similarity. Output one number from 0 to 100: 0 = definitely different speaker 100 = definitely same speaker
Do not explain your reasoning.
Probe utterances:
[probe utterance 1] (…)
Enrollment utterances:
[enrollment utterance 1] (…)
For attribute verification, the target and endpoint descriptions are replaced by same biological sex, same age group (<30, 30–60, or 60+), or same accent group (North America versus Other). The sex and age prompts ask the model to focus on stylistic and linguistic cues, whereas the accent prompt specifies vocabulary, phrasing, and linguistic markers. The complete task-specific prompts are included in the released code.

article.headline: 播客转录文本仍能认出说话人
article.lede: 新基准SPARC用150万条播客转录测试发现，大模型仅凭文字就能把同一说话人的两段话配对上。
article.problem: 此前的语音匿名化研究主要针对声学信号，但转录文本仍保留用词、句法和话语习惯，这些语言痕迹可能足以把匿名转录链接回已知说话人。已有工作显示，在控制对话话题后，说话人归因性能会下降，但这种性能下降是否也出现在现代大模型对手身上、以及能否同时验证性别、年龄、口音等人口属性标签，仍不清楚。
article.method: 作者构建了SPARC基准，数据取自两个公开英语播客语料NaturalVoices和SPoRC，包含超过12,500名说话人、150万条经质量过滤的话语，以及由源元数据提供或用模型推断的性别、年龄、口音标签。过滤流程要求信噪比不低于15 dB、去除含背景音乐的片段，并保留两个ASR模型词错率互相均不超过10%的片段。评测用五种基于表征或词频的基线和三个大模型（GPT-5-mini、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen3.5-9B），在说话人、性别、年龄组、口音四类成对验证任务上打分，并设置同集（同话题代理）与跨集（不同话题代理）条件，以及探针长度和注册文本量的消融实验。
article.results: 在跨集条件下，GPT-5-mini和Llama-3.3-70B的EER分别为0.285和0.281（NaturalVoices）、0.253和0.262（SPoRC），显著优于SentenceBERT的0.351和0.350；AUC为0.77–0.80对0.70。同集条件下嵌入模型明显退化，SentenceBERT从0.350升至0.460，接近0.5的随机水平，而两个最强LLM仍保持0.345和0.322。口音验证中GPT-5-mini跨集EER为0.268（AUC 0.771），性别验证LLM约0.377–0.420，年龄组则全部接近随机（最好的PCM为0.447）。把探针缩短到50词使GPT-5-mini的EER上升0.065、Llama上升0.047、SentenceBERT上升0.038，但仍未消除泄漏。在1%虚警率下，GPT-5-mini接受27.7%的正例，而Llama仅13.3%，尽管两者EER与AUC几乎相同。
article.why_it_matters: 结果表明，去掉声音、只保留文字并不等于去标识化：转录内容本身仍携带可链接到个人的信息，语音隐私评估应把语言内容与声纹一并考虑。同时，只报告EER或AUC会掩盖低虚警率下的真实链接风险。
article.limitations: 语料仅限英语播客，且经信噪比、音乐和双ASR一致性过滤后都是较干净的单说话人片段，结论未必适用于嘈杂、重叠语音或多语种场景。性别、年龄、口音标签多为模型推断而非核实的人口属性，年龄标签与人工多数一致率仅64%；三个LLM只用一个零样本提示、每对试验只生成一次，且打分集中在少数整数值，会限制低虚警率下的ROC分辨率。
article.figure_caption_zh: SPARC构建流程：从NaturalVoices和SPoRC筛选单人语音，按信噪比和背景音乐过滤，两个ASR模型一致率不低于90%时保留，并用源元数据或模型预测标注年龄、性别和口音。

figure.caption: Overview of the SPARC construction pipeline. Eligible single-speaker speech from NaturalVoices and SPoRC is filtered for SNR and background music, retained when two ASR models agree by at least 90\%, and annotated with age, sex, and accent labels from source metadata or model predictions.

journals.title: Three reasons why AI is not conscious and perhaps never will be
journals.summary:
Nature, Published online: 19 October 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03313-7

Large language models can mimic thought and feeling with uncanny skill. But evidence from neuroscience suggests that intelligence alone is not enough for subjective experience.
journals.blurb: 《Nature》在线发表评论文章，讨论为何大语言模型即便能逼真地模仿思考与情感，也可能并不具备主观意识。作者援引神经科学证据指出，仅凭智能本身并不足以产生主观体验。对关注模型能力边界与评测的研究生而言，这篇短文提供了一个区分“表现得像”与“真正拥有”的概念框架。

journals.title: Toxic chemicals in fentanyl revealed by speedy technique
journals.summary:
Nature, Published online: 19 October 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03317-3

Chemical fingerprinting charts the rises and declines of specific adulterants in illicit supplies of the drug.
journals.blurb: 《Nature》报道了一种快速化学指纹技术，用于追踪非法芬太尼供应中特定掺假物的出现与消退。该技术有望帮助识别有毒化学品的变化趋势，摘要未给出具体定量指标。
